subject: Got some problems with the gl.map.interactive

messages.author: 7d2a496980cff477
messages.subject: Got some problems with the gl.map.interactive
parts:
Hi everyone,

I got some problems with using the gl.map.interactive() command. The error message is: "Error in centers[, "lon"] : incorrect number of dimensions".

In the beginning, my genlight data file worked fine in using the gl.map.interactive() command. Then, I run the gl.edit.recode.pop() command to delete other populations and left only one population to look at its distributions in the map. I run the gl.compliance.check() command, and my data completed the check. Then I run the gl.map.interactive, and R gave me the error message.

I've checked the after editing genlight file (named lov1). I don't saw anywhere incorrect, I checked the lat and on in the genlight file with lov1@other$latlong, and the results looked like this(here only show the beginning two rows):
                                      lat             lon
ABTC109852 -28.23000 153.1400
ABTC90394  -28.57000 153.3700

All the commands I used is:
lov <- gl.edit.recode.pop(gl6)
popNames(lov)
gl.map.interactive(lov)
lov1 <- gl.compliance.check(lov)
gl.map.interactive(lov1)

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Got some problems with the gl.map.interactive
parts:
Hi,

There was a bug in the function gl.map.interactive() when the input was one population, which has been solved. To use this updated function you can install the developing version of dartR as described below.

I also noted that there was an error with gl.edit.recode.pop() when used to remove populations. Maybe for the moment, it would be better to use gl.keep.pop() or gl.drop.pop() instead of gl.edit.recode.pop() to remove populations.

Please let us know whether it worked for you.

Cheers,
Luis

# library required to install from github
library(devtools)
# installing developing version of dartR
install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR@dev")

# if you are working with R-studio restart your session with menu Session -> Restart R

library(dartR)
